name: Losing A Baby
overview: Scripture reveals God's intimate knowledge and care for life even before birth, as seen in Jeremiah 1:5 and Psalms 139:13, affirming that each child is known and formed by God. In the midst of grief from losing a baby, believers are reminded that the Lord is close to the brokenhearted and offers comfort to those who mourn (Psalms 34:18; Matthew 5:4). God’s promise to strengthen and uphold His people (Isaiah 41:10) encourages trust in His sustaining grace, while Jesus’ welcome of little children (Matthew 19:14) underscores their precious place in His kingdom.
